metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for agentvc, agent-first version control.

plugins.name: agentvc
plugins.description: Snapshot every edit into an agentvc attempt, drive the attempt tree over MCP, and fork, compare and promote attempts with slash commands.

plugins.name: agentvc-panel
plugins.description: The review UI's branch tree in a pane beside the chat: main, each window's stack, agent versions, with move, restack, conflicts and diffs.
